label.INDRENEW: Renewable generation as a proportion of Gross Final Electricity Consumption (GFEC)

result.label: Indicator - Renewable electricity
note:
[b]Renewable electricity[/b]

[b]How do we measure this?[/b]
Measures renewable generation as a proportion of Gross Final Electricity Consumption (GFEC). For this indicator a higher figure is better.

[b]Source[/b]
Electricity Consumption and Renewable Generation Statistics, Department for the Economy
[url=https://www.economy-ni.gov.uk/articles/electricity-consumption-and-renewable-generation-statistics]https://www.economy-ni.gov.uk/articles/electricity-consumption-and-renewable-generation-statistics[/url]

[b]Impact of Covid-19[/b]
There has been no change to the data collection methodology due to Covid-19.

[b]Further information[/b] 
1. The proportion is calculated using a 12 month rolling average.
2. Renewable generation includes all metered and own use renewable generation as the numerator. Gross Final Electricity Consumption includes all metered and own use renewable and non-renewable generation plus imports minus exports as the denominator.
3. The [url=https://www.economy-ni.gov.uk/articles/electricity-consumption-and-renewable-generation-statistics]publication[/url] also provides further analysis on monthly values and proportions for renewable generation, non-renewable generation, imports and exports.
4. Further detail is available in the “Technical and Background Notes” section of the [url=https://www.economy-ni.gov.uk/articles/electricity-consumption-and-renewable-generation-statistics]report[/url].
5. Change in methodology from measuring renewable generation as a % of metered electricity consumption to a % of Gross Final Electricity Consumption (GFEC). The new measure was first published in March 2026 and more information can be found at the following link: [url=https://www.economy-ni.gov.uk/publications/data-and-measurement-development-user-engagement-electricity-consumption-and-renewable-generation-statistics]https://www.economy-ni.gov.uk/publications/data-and-measurement-development-user-engagement-electricity-consumption-and-renewable-generation-statistics[/url]
